purpose.zh: 练手腕和肩，找到身体压在手上、脚离地的平衡
purpose.en: Builds your wrists and shoulders and teaches you to balance your weight on your hands.

text.zh: 膝盖架在大臂外侧，身体往前送到脚自己离地
text.en: Knees on the backs of your arms, lean until your feet float

text.zh: 手肘朝后弯着，膝盖压在手肘上面一掌的位置，别挂在肘尖上。
text.en: Elbows bent and pointing back; rest your knees a hand's width above the elbows, not on the tips.

text.zh: 先别急着抬脚，脚尖踩着往前倾，重量到了手上脚自然就轻了。
text.en: Don't lift your feet first. Lean forward on your toes; once your weight is on your hands they get light on their own.

text.zh: 肩膀往前过手腕、往下沉，手指张开抓地，往前栽了就用指尖按住。
text.en: Shoulders go forward past your wrists and down; spread your fingers, and press your fingertips if you start tipping forward.

commonErrors.en: Just falling forward without pressing the shoulders down.

commonErrors.zh: 手指没抓地，重量全在掌根
commonErrors.en: Fingers loose, all the weight on the heel of the hand.

commonErrors.zh: 重量还在脚上就硬抬脚，人往后坐
commonErrors.en: Yanking the feet up while the weight is still on them, so you sit back.

cautions.zh: 怕往前栽，就在脸前面放个枕头
cautions.en: If you're worried about tipping forward, put a pillow in front of your face.

cautions.zh: 脚尖离不了地，就先踮着脚把重量往手上送
cautions.en: If your toes won't lift yet, stay on tiptoe and shift weight to your hands.

cautions.zh: 别憋气，脚离地的时候照常喘气
cautions.en: Keep breathing while your feet are up; don't hold your breath.

thomasSupplement.camera: 正侧面为主（看前倾角度和脚离地）
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2 animation (8 s loop): 0.6 s squat on the toes, 1.4 s lean with the toes down, feet up 0.5 s, about 4 s with the feet off, feet down, lean back; elbows about 120 deg, shoulders about 23 cm past the wrists, knees resting on the upper arms above the elbows.

set.zh: 肩膀往前往下沉，手指抓地
set.en: Shoulders forward and down, fingers grip
